referents.why: 'their magic arts' belongs to the magicians named in the clause, the only masculine plural candidate.
third masculine plural 'they brought up' is the magicians of the verse.
referents.category: implied subject of a narrative clause

links.why: a bare id naming a clause of the previous verse; 'then' does not cross verses.
a wayyiqtol continues the narrative: they did the same, and then brought up the frogs.
'they did thus' is 'did the same' with a named subject who was not commanded; it copies the deed just done, Aaron stretching out his hand. Imitation, not fulfilment.
links.category: named person doing the same deed uncommanded
